title: Rldcoin: Permissionless Mining and Causal Interstellar Payments

This revision specifies direct CPU solo participation, exact portable owner intent, independently refreshed full evidence, sender-offline one-way custody, safe original-signature reconsideration and measurable payment usefulness. Survivor-1 consensus and exact issuance remain unchanged. Historical artifacts and receipts retain their original meaning.
qualification: Design and requirements publication only. G1-G8, T01-T22, D-T01-D-T08, independent security/custody and route qualification remain separate obligations. No mainnet, automatic adoption, test-value migration, profitable ordinary mining or irreversible isolated settlement is established.
acceptance: G1-G6 remain mandatory; G7 ordinary hardware and G8 causal payment usefulness add D-T01-D-T08. Supply cap, zero initial allocation, exact issuance, owner authorization, full native replay and independent qualification remain mandatory.
